\label{pp}

If $f:B(p,2r)\to\Ar$ is continuous, bounded, and positive at $p$,
then some $q\in B(p,2r)$ satisfies $f(q)\geq f(p)$ and, with
$\alpha=f(p)/f(q)$,
\[
 d(p,q)\leq2r(1-\alpha),\qquad
 f(q')<2f(q)\quad(q'\in B(q,\alpha r)).
\]
\end{corollary}
